profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I started out writing automated software validation systems, moved to writing support tools, then desktop software, and now write backend services. I'm active in local meetups and stay current with the latest technologies and methodologies. Constant improvement. Highly enthusiastic.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Working with the Azure Kubernetes Service team

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Video IP Engineering and Research team

[-] Engineering lead for a greenfield project to replicate and synchronize our entire storage array across national datacenters. 
[-] Engineering lead for a greenfield video-on-demand packager.

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.description:
Creative Cloud team

[-] APIs and supporting services for the sharing and collaboration of creative content
- Globally distributed and highly scalable micro services that are mostly written in Go
- Workers that support fan-out of jobs based on events and notifications as aggregated from various sources

[-] Port Creative Cloud's aging Ruby infrastructure to node.js
- Break apart Ruby monolith into node.js based micro services

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
DVA Tools, Adobe Media Encoder

[-] Video validation and reporting infrastructure
- Provides an automated service by which our desktop applications can submit video samples that are analyzed, frame by frame, reporting any perceptual artifacts, distortions, or color variations
Performance automation for our video-based desktop applications
- Per-build performance tracking and alerting of media engine

[-] Advisory role supporting various teams’ automation efforts
- Tool choices
- Determine what to track
- Systems design

[-] Media catalog service
- Create a repository for internal media resources used in software validation
- Search via Elasticsearch
- Automatic tagging and organization

positions.title: Software Developer in Test
positions.description:
Mediacore

[-] Bootstrap automated validation framework
- Validation media imports and exporters
- Sample accurate frame analysis
